newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Benpres lowers right offer price.
newsitem.headline: Benpres lowers right offer price.

text.p: Benpres Holdings Corp said on Monday it has decided to lower the proposed offer price for its pre-emptive offering to 7.0 pesos from 8.00 due to market conditions.
Benpres told the Securities and Exchange Commission it had changed the stock rights equation to a two for five rights offer compared to one for three planned earlier.
"There is no significant change as to the amount to be raised since the number of offer shares will be increased," Benpres said.
Benpres said it expects to raise 9.15 billion pesos from the offer involving 1.30 billion common shares.
It intends to use proceeds of the rights issue as equity investments in its affiliates.
Benpres proposed an offer period from July 7 to July 18 this year.
